mapper.select: SELECT address_id AS addressId, user_id AS userId, receiver, phone, zipcode, address, detail_address AS detailAddress, is_default AS isDefault FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = TRUE LIMIT 1

SELECT address_id AS addressId, user_id AS userId, receiver, phone, zipcode, address, detail_address AS detailAddress, is_default AS isDefault FROM user_address WHERE address_id = #{addressId} LIMIT 1

SELECT address_id AS addressId, user_id AS userId, receiver, phone, zipcode, address, detail_address AS detailAddress, is_default AS isDefault FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, address_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_address ( user_id, receiver, phone, zipcode, address, detail_address, is_default ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{receiver}, #{phone}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET is_default = FALSE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = TRUE
